app.name: SL CMS
app.landing: Choose a collection or a single page from the navigation.

auth.invalidCredentials: That identifier and password do not match.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
auth.elsewhere: This deployment signs users in through its identity provider.
auth.elsewhereWithLink: Sign in there, then return to this page.
auth.elsewhereWithoutLink: Sign in there, then return to this page. Ask an administrator for the address.
auth.signingInHint: Talking to the identity provider. This takes a moment.
auth.signInCancelled: The sign-in was cancelled or refused. Nothing was changed.
auth.signInNotOurs: This sign-in did not start in this tab. Sign in again from the sign-in screen.
auth.signInNotStarted: The sign-in could not be started in this browser.
auth.passwordTooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.resetNote: You followed a link an administrator issued. Choose a new password.
auth.passwordChangedOwn: Your password was changed. Other sessions have ended.
auth.passwordManagedElsewhere: This deployment signs you in through its identity provider, which holds your password; the CMS cannot change it. If you need a new one, an administrator resets it from the accounts screen, and the value you are handed is changed the next time you sign in.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.resourcesHint: On top of the account-wide role, permissions can be overridden per collection or single page. "No access" denies only that resource.
accounts.resetLinkCopied: Copied the reset link for {{user}} (valid until {{expires}}).
accounts.resetLinkNotCopied: Issued a reset link for {{user}} (valid until {{expires}}). It could not be copied, so copy it from below.
accounts.issueResetLinkFailed: Could not issue a reset link: {{message}}
accounts.failedToLoadSinglePages: Failed to load the single pages: {{message}}
accounts.resetPasswordCopied: Copied the temporary password for {{user}}. It has to be changed the next time they sign in.
accounts.resetPasswordNotCopied: Set a temporary password for {{user}}, shown below; it could not be copied, so read it out or copy it by hand. It has to be changed the next time they sign in.
accounts.temporaryPasswordHint: They change this the next time they sign in.

roles.viewerHint: Can read drafts, but cannot edit.
roles.editorHint: Can save changes; they reach the site only when published.

permissions.readOnly: You may not edit this content (view only).

content.noImagesUploadFirst: No images yet — upload one first.
content.unsavedHint: Not on the site until you publish.
content.unsavedEditsHint: These edits are only in the form. Saving and publishing sends them together.
content.publishNeedsSave: Save first: publishing sends the saved version, not the one in the form.
content.trashHint: Images taken out of the library. Content that uses one keeps working until it is deleted for good.
content.moveToTrashConfirm: Move {{name}} to the trash? You can put it back, and content using it keeps working.
content.trashFailed: Could not move the image to the trash: {{message}}
content.restoreFailed: Could not put the image back: {{message}}
content.usedByTrashConfirm: {{name}} is used by {{count}} piece(s) of content: {{list}}. Move it to the trash? They keep working until you delete it for good.
content.usedByDeleteConfirm: {{name}} is used by {{count}} piece(s) of content: {{list}}. Delete it for good? Their pictures will stop resolving.
content.failedToLoadReferences: Could not check what uses the image: {{message}}
content.leaveUnsaved: This screen has edits that have not been saved. Leave and lose them?
content.draftNotPublished: The saved content is not published yet. Press Publish changes to put it on the site.
content.previewCopied: The preview link was copied (valid until {{expires}}).
content.previewNotCopied: The preview link was created (valid until {{expires}}). It could not be copied, so copy it from below.
content.noFieldsInCollection: This collection has no fields yet. Add fields in the schema editor first.
content.noFieldsInPage: This page has no fields yet. Add fields in the schema editor first.
content.compositeFieldsHint: A composite field is a reusable group of fields. Collection and single page schemas can reference one by id, and its fields then appear inside that form.
content.imagesEmptyHint: No images yet. Upload one here, or from an image field while editing content.
content.imageTooLarge: This image is {{size}} MB; images may be up to {{max}} MB.
content.imageReplaced: The image was replaced. Content that uses it now shows the new one.
content.replaceFailed: The image could not be replaced: {{message}}
content.jsonArrayHint: Array values are edited as JSON.
content.arrayItemType: '{{field}}' is not one of the item types this array allows ({{types}}).
content.valueTooLong: '{{field}}' is longer than the {{max}} characters its schema allows.
content.valueTooShort: '{{field}}' is shorter than the {{min}} characters its schema allows.
content.compositeUndefined: Composite field '{{id}}' is not defined, so this value cannot be edited. Its existing value is kept.
content.relationJsonHintMany: References to the collection "{{target}}": a list of { "target": "{{target}}", "item": <id> }, any number of them.
content.relationJsonHintOne: A reference to the collection "{{target}}": a list with at most one { "target": "{{target}}", "item": <id> }.
content.relationJsonHintPage: A reference to the single page "{{target}}": a list with at most one { "target": "{{target}}" } — a page has no item id.
content.relationShape: '{{field}}' is not a reference: each one is an object with a target and, for a collection, an item id.
content.relationTargetMismatch: '{{field}}' does not name this field's target ({{target}}).
content.relationItemId: '{{field}}' needs the id of the item it points at.
content.relationPageHasNoItem: '{{field}}' points at a single page, which has no item id.
content.relationSingle: Field '{{field}}' holds one reference, so its list can hold at most one.
content.failedToLoadPages: The page list could not be loaded: {{message}}
content.failedToLoadPublishedState: Failed to load the published state: {{message}}
content.failedToChangePublished: Could not change the published state: {{message}}
content.failedToCreatePreviewLink: Could not create a preview link: {{message}}
content.deleteCollectionConfirm: Delete collection "{{name}}" and all of its items?
content.deletePageConfirm: Delete the single page "{{name}}" and its content?
content.renameFailed: The image could not be renamed: {{message}}
content.invalidImageName: A file name is required, and cannot contain a path separator.

errors.invalid_credentials: That ID and password do not match.
errors.invalid_token: Your session is not valid. Sign in again.
errors.session_ended: This session ended when the password changed. Sign in again.
errors.not_provisioned: This account has not been given access to the CMS.
errors.invalid_username: An ID of up to 128 letters, digits or + = , . @ _ - is required.
errors.last_administrator: The last administrator cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.payload_too_large: The request was larger than this deployment accepts.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.not_implemented: This deployment does not support that.
errors.value_taken: The value of '{{field}}' is already used by another item.
errors.field_too_long: '{{field}}' is longer than its schema allows.
errors.field_too_short: '{{field}}' is shorter than its schema allows.
errors.field_type_mismatch: '{{field}}' does not accept a value of this kind.
errors.invalid_enum_value: '{{field}}' holds a value that is not one of its options.
errors.unknown_composite_field: '{{field}}' refers to a composite field that does not exist.
errors.composite_id_mismatch: '{{field}}' holds a different composite field than the schema names.
errors.nested_arrays: '{{field}}' holds an array inside an array, which is not supported.
errors.invalid_slug: '{{field}}' has nothing a URL could use: a slug is made of letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.draft_changed: This item was saved again while it was being published. What you see is not what is stored: open it again and publish once more.
errors.image_not_trashed: Put the image in the trash first, then delete it for good.
errors.still_referenced: Other content references this, so it was not deleted. Remove those references first.

schema.arrayTypeTagHint: Array items carry no type tag, so Number and Image cannot be combined.
schema.relationTargetHint: Only collections and single pages that exist can be chosen.
schema.relationNoTargets: There is nothing of this kind yet.
schema.relationInverseHint: What the other side calls this relation, for screens and for ?populate=. A label: nothing is stored on the target.
schema.arrayItemTypesHere: Array item types are configured on the field itself.
schema.orderHint: Drag the handle (or use the arrows) to set the order, and choose a width to control how the fields are laid out on the content editing screen.
schema.arrayCompositeHint: Which composite definitions this array may hold.
schema.arrayNoCompositeTypes: No composite fields are defined yet.
schema.unique: Must be unique in this collection
schema.uniqueHint: Checked when the schema is saved, against the items already stored.
schema.showInListHint: Adds this field to the collection's list, so an editor can tell the items apart there.
schema.slugGenerateHint: The field the content editor may fill the slug from, when asked.

labels.issueResetLinkOf: issue a password reset link for {{username}}
labels.restoreImage: put image {{id}} back in the library
labels.selectAllItems: select every item on this page
